root_cause.text: In ice_set_ringparam(), the error paths for failing to allocate rx_rings or failing to set up an individual Rx ring do not free the previously allocated xdp_rings (and in one case also tx_rings), causing memory leaks.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states that "tx_rings and xdp_rings are allocated before rx_rings. If the allocation of rx_rings fails, the code jumps to the done label leaking both tx_rings and xdp_rings. Furthermore, if the setup of an individual Rx ring fails during the loop, the code jumps to the free_tx label which releases tx_rings but leaks xdp_rings." The patch introduces a new `free_xdp` label and updates the error goto targets to free xdp_rings before exiting.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix incorrect error handling in ice_set_ringparam to ensure XDP resources are freed on memory allocation failure.
intent_record.what: Changed the error handling jump target from 'done' to 'free_xdp' when memory allocation for 'rx_rings' fails in 'ice_set_ringparam'.
intent_record.how: Previously, a failure to allocate 'rx_rings' would skip cleanup of XDP resources by jumping to the 'done' label. Now it jumps to 'free_xdp', which includes necessary cleanup for XDP-related allocations, preventing resource leaks.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix incorrect error cleanup path that could leave XDP rings unfreed on rx_rings allocation failure.
intent_record.what: Changed the goto target from 'free_tx' to 'free_xdp' in the error handling path when allocation of rx_rings fails within ice_set_ringparam.
intent_record.how: When kmemdup_array for rx_rings returns NULL, the code now jumps to 'free_xdp' label instead of 'free_tx', presumably to also free any xdp_rings that may have been allocated earlier, ensuring proper cleanup.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add cleanup of XDP rings in error path of ice_set_ringparam to prevent memory leak
intent_record.what: Added a new label 'free_xdp:' with code to free XDP rings (loops over XDP TX queues and frees each ring, then kfrees the array) before the existing 'free_tx:' label.
intent_record.how: Ensures that XDP rings are properly deallocated when an error occurs during ring parameter setting, preventing memory leaks by jumping to the new cleanup label.

Author: Anirudh Venkataramanan <anirudh.venkataramanan@intel.com>
Date:   Tue Mar 20 07:58:16 2018 -0700

    ice: Add stats and ethtool support
    
    This patch implements a watchdog task to get packet statistics from
    the device.
    
    This patch also adds support for the following ethtool operations:
    
    ethtool devname
    ethtool -s devname [msglvl N] [msglevel type on|off]
    ethtool -g|--show-ring devname
    ethtool -G|--set-
bic_trace_step.reason: In ice_set_ringparam(), when rx_rings allocation fails (line 'if (!rx_rings) { err = -ENOMEM; goto done; }'), the code jumps to 'done' without freeing previously allocated tx_rings (if any). This causes a memory leak of tx_rings. The fix (freeing tx_rings in that error path) is not present.
